data.name: AlJabbar
data.long_meaning: The name AlJabbar is derived from the Arabic root j-b-r, which means to be compact or to press together. In Islamic context, it is used to describe Allah (God) as The Compeller, The Almighty, The All-Powerful, The Irresistible, and The Unstoppable. This name signifies strength, power, and authority.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine power and unwavering faith.

in_arabic.name: الجبّار
in_arabic.meaning: الله عز وجل القادر على كل شيء، الجبار للأشياء
in_arabic.long_meaning: الجبّار هو اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الذي يجبر الأشياء و يقهرها، و هو القادر على كل شيء، و الجبار للأشياء، و يوحي بالقدرة و القوة و الإرادة الإلهية.

in_urdu.name: الجبار
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ جو ہر چیز پر قادر ہے، جبار
in_urdu.long_meaning: الجبار اللہ تعالیٰ کا ایک نام ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وہ جو ہر چیز کو جبر کرے، یا وہ جو ہر چیز پر قادر ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں بہت اہم ہے، خاص طور پر درس نظامی اور صوفیازم میں.

in_hindi.name: अलजब्बार
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह तआला जो हर चीज़ पर قادر है, जब्बार
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलजब्बार अल्लाह तआला का एक नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है वह जो हर चीज़ को मजबूर करे, या वह जो हर चीज़ पर قادر है, और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, खासकर सूफीवाद और दर्विश परंपरा में.

in_pashto.name: الجبّار
in_pashto.meaning: الله تعالی چې پر هر شي قادر دی، جبار
in_pashto.long_meaning: الجبّار د الله تعالی یو نوم دی، چې معنی یې ده هغه چې هر شي ته جبري قوت ورکوي، یا هغه چې پر هر شي قادر دی، او دا نوم د افغان او پښتون مسلم دودیزو کې ډیر مهم دی.

in_english.name: AlJabbar
in_english.meaning: The Almighty, The Powerful, The Compeller
in_english.long_meaning: AlJabbar is one of the Names of Allah, meaning The Powerful, The Compeller, or The Almighty. It is derived from the Arabic root 'J-B-R', which connotes the idea of power, strength, and compulsion. In Islamic tradition, AlJabbar is associated with the attributes of divine power and authority. The name is mentioned in various Quranic contexts, emphasizing God's ability to overcome and dominate all things.

It is often used in invocations, supplications, and prayers to seek Allah's help and guidance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name AlJabbar holds profound spiritual significance for Muslims as it represents the ultimate power and sovereignty of Allah. It is a reminder of His ability to compel all things to submit to His will and to remind us of our duty to submit to Him voluntarily. It is also a source of comfort and strength in times of hardship, as it reminds us that Allah is in control and that we can turn to Him for support and protection. The name AlJabbar encourages Muslims to develop inner strength and resilience, to trust in Allah's power and wisdom, and to strive to live in accordance with His commands.
